changelog: Aura AI v2.0.5 Pure White Theme & Refined Sidebar
Pure White/Light Theme Everywhere: Complete elimination of dark mode across all screens, settings, dialogs, drawers, and menus with readable dark status & nav bar icons
Sidebar Background Match: Drawer background matching Chat/Voice off-white token (#F9F9FB) with zero tonal elevation tint
28dp Rounded Drawer: Rounded right corners (28dp) with soft right-edge shadow
24sp SemiBold Aura AI Header: Clean typography with -0.2sp letter spacing and 44dp circular elevated search button
Soft 3D Elevated Menu Cards: White elevated 52dp cards (Images, Customize, Projects, Tasks, Plugins) with 10dp gap and rounded ripple feedback
Elevated Footer Buttons: 48dp white circular gear button and 48dp teal circular initials avatar
Retry Pill: 44dp white elevated pill with blue text for clean error recovery
